Challenge your imagination as you battle the mightiest villains in an exciting, action-filled adventure through GOTHAM CITY, METROPOLIS, ATLANTIS and other iconic locales from the DC Comics Universe.

notes.title: Netherrealm's DC superhero fighter Injustice: Gods Among Us is now an animated movie
notes.content:
Fans of super-person pile-ons and animated stuff are in luck; developer Netherrealm's acclaimed superhero fighting series Injustice: Gods Among Us is getting the animated movie treatment courtesy of DC and Warner Bros. Animation.

That's according to the Hollywood Reporter, which says the film - to be released under the DC Animated Movie banner - will draw inspiration from Netherrealm's video game titles as well as writer Tom Taylor's Injustice: Gods Among Us: Year One, a comic book prequel to the games.

Its animated action will reportedly unfold on an alternate version of Earth where the Joker has successfully managed to trick Superman into killing Lois Lane, sending the superhero on a rampage of destruction. "This unhinged Superman decides to take control of Earth for its own good," says the Hollywood Reporter, "leading Batman and his allies to attempt to stop him."

Read more

notes.title: Game Update, September 15, 2014
notes.content:
NetherRealm and Warner Bros. have released a patch today for Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition to fix some issues related to Online and Framerate – details below: 
[list]
    [*]Fixed issue related to players not being visible in rooms 
    [*]Fixed the invite system to address simultaneous invites and invites that arrive after the player has started entering a match
o	Note: This fix changes the system so that invites arriving after entering a match or actively matchmaking are ignored
    [*]Fixed a desync when using chat in Big Picture mode 
    [*]Fixed framerate issue related to cutscenes
[/list]
We would like to clarify that a good network connection and a system capable of maintaining 60 fps are required in order to receive the best possible online experience:
[olist]
    [*]Start with a machine that meets or exceeds the Recommended System Requirements 
    [*]Run AutoConfigure from the Video Settings Option menu 
    [*]If you experience any further performance problems, disable the most costly effects such as Anti-Aliasing 
    [*]Make sure to watch the Ping display for opponents that have a rating of (4 = Good). Connections to a lower Ping value may slow down online play
[/olist]

notes.title: Finding Players Online Improved
notes.content:
A game update was released today for Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition that extends online multiplayer matchmaking across all regions.

The original game was set to limit matches to players within the closest geographical region to improve the chances of quality online play (better ping times).  However, this had the inadvertent effect of limiting some regions, such as Australia and New Zealand as well as Ireland and other European countries from matchmaking with the bulk of the Injustice community.

This update changes Steam matchmaking to cover the full worldwide region.  Players should no longer need to adjust their Steam download region to find opponents.

notes.title: Patch Released
notes.content:
A patch was released today for Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition to fix several issues related to online multiplayer matchmaking and graphics card compatibility.

Players with Steam auto-updates enabled will automatically receive this patch.  Please try out the updated game and let us know if you have any problems.  Warner Bros. is actively monitoring posts in this Steam community forum.

[b]List of Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues causing players to be stuck at the ‘looking for opponents’ screen 
[*] Fixed issues related to the Join Game system 
[*] Fixed a problem with players getting stuck in lobbies in Survivor if one player disconnects at a critical time 
[*] Fixed crashes related to Steam invites 
[*] Fixed a problem where players are unable to join a Player KOTH/Survivor match of 6 or more people if someone leaves 
[*] Fixed a problem where players get stuck in their own rooms and cannot progress in Survivor and KOTH matches 
[*] Fixed a problem where DLC characters and skins become no longer available after inviting a player to KOTH or Survivor that has not booted the game
[*] Fixed a black screen crash when Shadow Quality option on NVIDIA cards is set to max 
[*] Added proper support for NVIDIA Optimus chipset 
[*] Fixed a problem with ATOC support on AMD cards
[/list]

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Tip
notes.content:
Injustice, like most fighting games at the competitive level, has online play that allows for frame-accurate inputs, all of which are meticulously tuned against 60 FPS gameplay.  As such, while the game does still attempt to match players across all FPS, the vast majority of Injustice players connecting online will be playing the game with graphical settings for their computer that ensures a constant 60 FPS playback.

If you are having difficulty finding other players online or your ping meter shows red occasionally, it is possible that the framerate of the game is dropping below 60 FPS due to your computer's settings.  A low framerate will limit the ability for you to connect to players with high framerates.  Try adjusting your graphical settings to the lowest possible in order to maintain at least 60 FPS before attempting to connect online
